# SpaceCorps API · LLM Agent Index

> Machine-readable REST API documentation, schemas, and endpoint specifications for SpaceCorps simulation clusters and game servers.

- OpenAPI JSON: https://spacecorps.github.io/openapi.json
- OpenAPI YAML: https://spacecorps.github.io/openapi.yaml
- Authentication: https://spacecorps.github.io/auth.md
- Base URL: https://spaceemit-api.sliplane.app
- Model Context Protocol (MCP): https://spacecorps.github.io/server.json

## Endpoints
- `GET /health`: Cluster health and readiness.
- `GET /api/v1/telemetry`: Active physics simulation and player counts.
- `POST /v1/batch`: Batch / bulk request execution.
- `POST /v1/jobs`: Asynchronous simulation job creation (returns 202 Accepted).
- `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}`: Poll asynchronous job execution status.
